title: Double-complex model for the Grothendieck spectral sequence
statement: For a composable pair $(F,G)$ as in [thm-sp-grothendieck], an object $X$, an injective resolution $X\to I^\bullet$, and a Cartan--Eilenberg resolution $C^{\bullet,\bullet}$ of $F(I^\bullet)$ as in [thm-sp-if-e1], the Grothendieck spectral sequence of [thm-sp-grothendieck] with its abutment filtration is the spectral sequence of the first filtration of the total complex $\operatorname{Tot}G(C^{\bullet,\bullet})$ in [thm-sp-double-complex-spectral-sequences]. Its $E_2$-page is $E_2^{p,q}=R^pG(R^qF(X))$, its abutment is identified with $R^n(G\circ F)(X)$ through $H^n(G(F(I^\bullet)))$, and the left edge map of [lem-sp-grothendieck-edge-maps] is the edge map of this filtered double-complex spectral sequence, namely the quotient of the abutment $H^n=F^0H^n$ onto $F^0H^n/F^1H^n=E_\infty^{0,n}$ followed by the inclusion $E_\infty^{0,n}\subseteq E_2^{0,n}$.
